en.headline: High Court grants Pansy Ho permanent harassment injunction
en.dek: A deputy judge found repeated approaches and false allegations since March 2025 justified a lasting order keeping the defendant away from Ho and her offices.
body: The High Court on Wednesday granted Pansy Ho Chiu-king a permanent injunction restraining a woman from contacting her, approaching her properties or the offices of MGM China Holdings and Shun Tak Holdings, or publishing false or derogatory material about her.

Deputy Judge Chow Chiu-man said in a written judgment that Ho had properly pleaded repeated harassment since March 2025 by Steffi Chen Pan-yu, a former licensed broker, including emails and hand-delivered letters containing false allegations. The judge said the conduct caused distress and that a permanent order was appropriate to stop further interference.

Ho, executive chairwoman of Shun Tak Holdings and chairwoman of MGM China, sued after the defendant failed to file a defence. The court accepted that threats of legal action based on false statements had been used to press her. Local reports of the judgment said Ho did not pursue a damages award and that the defendant was ordered to pay costs.
The civil case is HCA 528/2026. The findings are those of the court on the papers before it and do not amount to a criminal conviction.

zh.headline: 高院向何超瓊頒永久禁制令禁騷擾
zh.dek: 暫委法官裁定被告自2025年3月起重複接觸及作出失實指控，禁制對方聯絡何超瓊或靠近其公司辦事處。
body: 高等法院星期三向何超瓊頒下永久禁制令，禁止一名女子接觸她、進入她持有的物業，或進入美高梅中國控股及信德集團辦事處30米範圍，亦不得發布虛假或貶損資料。
暫委法官周昭雯在判詞指，何超瓊已妥當申述前持牌經紀陳芃余自2025年3月起重複騷擾，包括電郵及面交信件載有失實指控，行為造成困擾，永久禁制令屬合適濟助。
何超瓊為信德集團執行主席兼董事總經理，亦是美高梅中國主席。被告未有存檔抗辯，原告早前申請判決獲批。判詞接納被告曾以失實陳述威脅採取法律行動。本地報道指原告放棄追討損害賠償，法庭下令被告支付訟費。
案件編號HCA528/2026。上述為民事判決所載事實，並非刑事定罪。
